QuestInfo.name: Lost Property
QuestInfo.0:
Something feels empty. Did you lose something?

Oh, no -- you've lost your only photograph of your older brother. You must've dropped it while hunting the sparrows. Father told you not to stay out too long...

#r(If you fail, forfeit the quest and start it again.)
